title: トワイライトシンドローム 究明編
sources: Headless replay from power-on: each of the seven chapters started in turn and made to draw every code it has, and the drawn glyphs matched against the chapter's font from the disc

The 1,153 kanji and Latin glyphs read by eye, then checked by decoding every scene's script from the disc against a word list (nine readings corrected); the 18 codes no scene uses are read by eye only
The chapter byte found by comparing memory at each chapter's first scene
The two wait codes and the script position seen in a replay of chapter 6's first scene: 60 presses through three scripts, the position compared with the script at each stop

Ten Genkan snapshots of real play in chapter 5 (two conversations, then walking): both scripts decode with no unmapped code, the lines on screen are where the position says, and the waiting and window flags follow the screen
notes: Not Tansaku-hen's table (SLPS-00102). 16-bit little-endian codes: 0x0000-0x00DB are shared; kanji are 0x00DC up and each chapter numbers its own, so one of SLPS-00405-ch5.tbl, -ch6, -ch7, -ch8, -ch9, -chA, -chH must follow, chosen by the byte at 0x80016635 (0-6 in that order). The format can't choose a table yet, so only the shared one is listed and kanji read as unmapped. The script is at 0x801FE800; a u16 counts the words read, at 0x800AAABE in chapter 5 and 0x800A80E2 in chapter 6 (others unknown); the table has the flags beside it. No layout: a page cursor must be an address.
